visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty five: it's all cats (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js airport gate (patterned carpet, a glass wall onto the apron with a parked plane, a pillar with a GATE 14 board, back-to-back rows of seats, a pink suitcase, a bin), box-built traveller with curly red hair, freckles, a denim jacket and a yellow neck pillow who ends up lying across three seats, phone sheets for storage full / deleting recents / recently deleted / a chat with herself holding a pixelated thumbnail / YourBrand Content drafts / a draft playing with its review / storage full of cats, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.7 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: at an airport gate her phone storage is full, so she deletes things: forty takes of one sentence, a cat video, and her final video, the one she owes the brand today. She empties the bin too. The backup in a chat with herself is the thumbnail. She lies across three seats. Then YourBrand: her drafts go up to the Content page, every version stays there with its review; phone full, she presses play and it's still there. Her phone is full again. It's all cats.
